user.title: Sensors and existing day periods
user.description: Select existing HA entities. All fields except name, main temperature and period are optional. For cooking use a binary sensor/helper; numeric stove power needs a template binary sensor.

devices.title: Appliances
devices.description: Climate appliances must support heat/cool and off. A radiator surface sensor is required for fan control. For switch/light relays, any positive speed request means fully on; 0 means off. Relays cannot enforce a reduced night speed. Exhausts support fan/switch/light for observation only.

periods.title: Period mapping and temperatures
periods.description: Copy the exact states from Developer Tools → States, not translated display labels. Existing alarm and day-period automations remain authoritative.

data.pre_sleep_state: Preparing for sleep: exact HA state

policy.title: Control and ventilation limits
policy.description: Control is disabled by default. Before enabling, switch selected appliances off and disable conflicting climate automations. Thresholds are adjustable starting values, not air-quality guarantees.
